data.content:
apiVersion: openslo/v1
kind: SLO
metadata:
  annotations:
    datafocal/group-by: endpoint
  name: gateway
spec:
  alertPolicies:
  - kind: AlertPolicy
    metadata:
      name: burn
    spec:
      conditions:
      - kind: AlertCondition
        metadata:
          annotations:
            datafocal/short-window: 5m
          name: fast
        spec:
          condition:
            kind: burnrate
            lookbackWindow: 1h
            op: gte
            threshold: 14.4
          severity: page
  budgetingMethod: Occurrences
  indicator:
    spec:
      ratioMetric:
        good:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"} | status<500'
            type: DataFocal
        total:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"}'
            type: DataFocal
  objectives:
  - target: 0.99
  service: gateway
  timeWindow:
  - duration: 1d
    isRolling: true
---
apiVersion: openslo/v1
kind: SLO
metadata:
  annotations:
    datafocal/group-by: endpoint
  name: gateway-prometheus
spec:
  alertPolicies:
  - kind: AlertPolicy
    metadata:
      name: burn
    spec:
      conditions:
      - kind: AlertCondition
        metadata:
          annotations:
            datafocal/short-window: 5m
          name: fast
        spec:
          condition:
            kind: burnrate
            lookbackWindow: 1h
            op: gte
            threshold: 14.4
          severity: page
  budgetingMethod: Occurrences
  indicator:
    spec:
      ratioMetric:
        good:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"} | status < 500'
            type: Prometheus
        total:
          metricSource:
            spec:
              query: '{service="gateway"}'
            type: Prometheus
  objectives:
  - target: 0.9
  service: gateway
  timeWindow:
  - duration: 1d
    isRolling: true
